sports/nba/data/features_v1_evidence.jso.claims: v1 as-of feature build: 25,258 games, per-season game counts, home-court Elo edge (70.4 -> 56.5) and home-win rate (0.603 -> 0.544), final Elo top-10.

sports/nba/data/features_v2_evidence.jso.claims: v2 as-of feature build (v1 keys + availability): same per-season coverage and final Elo top-10, plus the availability_coverage block (publication rule, REPLACEMENT_LEVEL prior, 25,228 authoritative / 30 unknown games). The A6 feature payload.

sports/nba/data/features_v3_evidence.jso.claims: v3 as-of feature build (v2 keys + signed player-impact absence values). Phase-2 A7 arm input (docs/preregistration.md 13). Same coverage block as v2 - impact shares the authoritative-list rule, so the eligible-row set is identical.

sports/nba/data/features_v4_evidence.jso.claims: v4 as-of feature build (v3 keys + schedule spots: 5-day travel, altitude venue, 4-in-5 / 3-in-4 away, homestand/roadtrip runs). Phase-2 A8 arm input (docs/preregistration.md 13). Same coverage block as v2/v3.

sports/nba/data/formula_v1.json.claims: Fitted A5 formula (market-free logistic): 7 named coefficients, intercept, standardiser means/sds, and the frozen train/tune windows.

sports/nba/data/formula_v1_report.json.claims: A5 development report: per-season and pooled metrics, plus the current books-only 2021-22 sigma_d recompute (0.08522, n=1,227). The registered pre-registration lock is 0.08497 (n=1,227); it was measured on the pre-contamination-fix market arm and is carried in docs/preregistration.md and tests/evidence/nba_published_numbers.py, not re-derived from this artifact.

sports/nba/data/nba_ablation_v1.json.claims: Drop-one-signal ablation for A5 and A6: pooled and per-season delta-Brier for every named feature (exploratory). Regenerated after the replacement-level prior / publication-marker change.

sports/nba/data/nba_availability_v1.json.claims: Exploratory A6 arm (A5 + availability): coefficients, per-season and pooled A5-vs-A6 metrics, paired tests, and the 0.00723 -> 0.00444 gap-to-open verdict (A6 pooled Brier 0.21053, A6-vs-A5 mean_diff 0.00279).

sports/nba/data/nba_calibration_v1.json.claims: Tune-only calibration bake-off: raw/Platt/isotonic for A5 and A6 fitted on 2021-22 (A5 ships isotonic, A6 ships Platt), their single frozen-test evaluation (A5 shipped Brier 0.21452 vs raw 0.21303; A6 shipped 0.21091 vs raw 0.21053) and paired tests. Registered A5 verdicts unchanged.

sports/nba/data/nba_market_structure_v1..claims: Market structure on the 4,888-game open+close block: Brier levels for formula/open/close and the market's own open-to-close improvement.

sports/nba/data/nba_phase2_arm_2026_27.j.claims: season_gate.py -- the SEALED 2026-27 claim arm: the admitted A7 structure (17 frozen features), weights fit ONCE on the expanding window <= 2025-26 (n=25,212), sealed with body digest 2bf068c9b5cea7b51ff32e1d5981e1cb1d626e4a0f036de2d73082c33e6865e5. The single 2026-27 claim read (docs/preregistration.md 13) may only score against this arm; any refit during or after the season is retrospective work.

sports/nba/data/nba_phase2_gate_a7.json.claims: Phase-2 tune gate (fit <= 2020-21, scored on 2021-22): A7 (impact absences) 0.21573 vs A6 0.21591, verdict 'enter' under the pre-registered strict-improvement rule (docs/preregistration.md 13). Development evidence only: claim_eligible=false. Record renamed per-arm from nba_phase2_gate.json (bytes unchanged).

sports/nba/data/nba_phase2_gate_a8.json.claims: Phase-2 tune gate (fit <= 2020-21, scored on 2021-22): A8 (A7 + schedule spots) 0.21598 vs A6 0.21591, verdict 'rejected' - the spots arm does not enter the Phase-2 freeze (docs/preregistration.md 13 arm admission log); its T3 prior is lowered accordingly. sports/nba/data/nba_walkforward_v1_conta.claims: Historical pre-fix ledger (in-play feed rows leaked into the closing arm). Preserved only as evidence of the documented contamination bug fix; never claim from it.
